# SPD-027 — Stop hook's Law 9 reason names --next on member finish

## Brief
Since SPD-011, Spud's member finish of a root member writes the report entry and takes --next for its Next line. hook_stop's reason, which tells a held Spud how to record a returned member, still shows member finish without --next, so the entry he records from it has no Next line unless he remembers the flag. hook_stop belongs to SPD-018's open branch, so this waits for both merges.

Evidence: bin/spud hook_stop: the reason reads 'Record each with spud --as spud member finish <SPUD-nnn/Name> --status done|blocked|failed --outcome <verdict> [--summary <one paragraph>]'. Branch worktree-spd-011-reports-from-events adds member finish --next (cmd_member_finish, check_next). SubagentStop's stop_hold_reason must not gain it: a nested parent's --next is exit 3.
